articles.title: As crypto perpetual futures boom, Ethereum’s role is shifting
articles.snippet: Rather than competing directly with faster chains, some builders argue Ethereum's strength lies in supporting the layer-2 networks where trading is taking place.

articles.title: Fed holds rates steady, extending pause as markets await Kevin Warsh's policy roadmap
articles.snippet: For the first time in several years, markets were somewhat split on whether the U.S. central bank would hike rates.

articles.title: The traditional 9-to-5 banking day is officially dying, says Morgan Stanley execs
articles.snippet: Tokenization and 24/7 markets are reshaping finance, making always-on banking a reality.

articles.title: Stablecoin firm Brale says new protocol can remove a major hurdle to scaling custom tokens
articles.snippet: Today's bridge model won't scale as hundreds of companies issue their own stablecoins, fragmenting liquidity, Brale CEO Ben Milne said in an interview.

articles.title: Coinbase hit by spot trading slump: Wall Street trims expectations ahead of earnings
articles.snippet: Wall Street expects a sluggish second quarter from Coinbase as crypto trading activity cools, putting all eyes on and pending U.S. crypto legislation.
